scripts.build:prod: vite build --mode production && cd worker && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=../dist/_worker.js --external:cloudflare:* --external:node:*
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build:prod && cd worker && npx wrangler pages deploy ../dist --project-name=photo-album
scripts.deploy: npm run build:prod && cd worker && wrangler deploy
scripts.android:build: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
